# ADDENDUM 9 — July 4, 2026 session (brand + bio revisions; deck/one-pager v2)

## 70. LOGO REDESIGN — "Synapse N" (emphasizing the NEURO in NeuRobots)

Per Josh's direction, the logo was redesigned to "show something brainy" and emphasize the neuro half of the name. Three concepts were presented:
- **A · Synapse N** — the existing node-based N rebuilt as a neural network: N strokes formed by connected nodes, amber nodes reading as firing synapses. Safest evolution of the current mark.
- **B · Node brain** — literal brain silhouette with a neural network firing inside.
- **C · Neuro + circuit** — split mark: half organic brain (neuro), half circuit traces (bots).

**Selected: Concept A (Synapse N)** — "for now," so B and C remain on file as alternates.

**Mark specification (Concept A):**
- Navy circle background (#14213D on light surfaces, #1B2A40 on dark slides)
- N formed by three cream (#F4EFE6) strokes with cream nodes at the four corner terminals and mid-stroke points
- Amber (#F59E1C) synapse nodes: one at the N's center crossing, one "crown" node above the N (largest amber node), and two small satellite nodes off the left and right mid-points
- Thin (~40% opacity) cream connector lines from the N to the crown and satellite nodes — the "synapses firing"
- Small/footer version simplifies to the N strokes + four cream corner nodes + single amber center node
- Deployed on: deck title slide, closing slide, all slide footers, one-pager header

## PROCESS LESSONS (49–51)
49. **Language in bios carries founder philosophy.** "Owns" read to Josh as contradicting the team's collaborative work with AI — bio verbs are positioning statements, not filler. Prefer "leads" and confirm role labels with the founder rather than inferring them.
50. **Present visual concepts before regenerating materials.** Showing three logo directions inline and getting a pick (plus the eyebrow-label choice) before rebuilding avoided a wasted 17-slide regeneration cycle — consistent with lesson 28 (lock direction before iterating).
51. **Keep editable sources alongside PDF deliverables.** The v1 deck survived only as a rendered PDF; the v2 rebuild required reconstructing every slide from page images. HTML sources for deck + one-pager are now part of the working method — regenerate from source for all future revisions.

*Summary of Addendum 9: the LOGO was redesigned to the "Synapse N" (Concept A — neural-network N with amber synapse nodes; concepts B "Node brain" and C "Neuro + circuit" archived as alternates); JOSH'S BIO was reframed per his correction — "owns" removed everywhere in favor of "leads," eyebrow changed to Co-Founder · Business & Capital, IT experience and MS in MIS emphasized; PAT'S BIO gained 20 years of competitive China sourcing and 8 years of India IT support; DECK v2 and ONE-PAGER v2 were regenerated with these changes (all other content unchanged from v1), rebuilt via HTML → PDF since no editable v1 source existed; pending items updated (docx one-pager, Chinese deck propagation, optional Slide-10 eyebrow rename). Three new process lessons (49–51). All prior content v14–v23 (Addenda 1–8) preserved unchanged.*
